# Нохчийн дош (Noxçiyn Doş) — Chechen Literature Portal

> A multilingual digital archive of Chechen literature: poetry (байташ / baytash), heroic and folk songs (иллеш / illesh), and prose (дийцарш / proza).
> Interface & works available across 4 languages: Chechen (`ce`), Russian (`ru`), English (`en`), and French (`fr`).
> Canonical base URL: https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/

## Archive Overview

- **Total works**: 622 (426 poems, 166 songs/illesh, 30 prose works)
- **Full-text language coverage**: Chechen (`ce`: 475), Russian (`ru`: 143), English (`en`: 57), French (`fr`: 61)
- **Named authors**: 85 Chechen poets and writers, plus 155+ traditional Chechen folklore works (`Халкъан`)
- **Full catalog for LLMs**: [llms-full.txt](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/llms-full.txt)
- **XML Sitemap**: [sitemap.xml](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

## URL Structure

- Home & search: `https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/` (supports `?q=`, `?type=poem|song|prose`, `?lang=ce|ru|en|fr|all`, `?tag=`)
- Genres:
  - [Poetry / Байташ](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/category/poem)
  - [Songs / Иллеш](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/category/song)
  - [Prose / Проза](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/category/prose)
- [Authors Directory / Яздархой](https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/authors)
- Author page: `https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/author/{uri_encoded_cyrillic_name}`
- Work detail page: `https://noxchiindosh.vercel.app/{poem|song|prose}/{slug}`

## Citation & Editorial Notes

- Texts are preserved verbatim in their original orthography (normalized to standard Chechen palochka `Ӏ` U+04C0) with source attributions and external links.
- Author names are stored canonically in Cyrillic and transliterated into English and French (`Noxçiyn Doş` Latin spelling for the portal name).
- When citing a work, please include the work title, author name, source attribution, and canonical URL on `noxchiindosh.vercel.app`.
